# Health Connect product icon

`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/health_connect_logo.png` is the unmodified transparent PNG supplied for integrations by Google / Android Developers.

Source: https://developer.android.com/static/downloads/assets/health_connect_logo.png

Usage guidance: https://developer.android.com/health-and-fitness/health-connect/ui/guidelines

The icon identifies the Android Health Connect integration and is displayed on white, following the source guidance. It is not a SleepWell brand asset. Health Connect and its product icon belong to Google.
